warnings.title: Corrected (re-queued) rows hide the attempt-log timeline and export — the correction event is suppressed for every corrected row while queued
warnings.detail: AC1: 'Given a started row ... covering every send, form-opened, correction, takeover, substitution, and terminal event.' Correction re-queues to 'queued'; the Queued arm suppresses the log unless taken over, so the correction event (and the pre-correction sends) vanish from the panel the moment the landlord corrects — until T0 re-claims or the row terminals. The queued body also claims 'not started' for a row that clearly started.
warnings.recommended_fix: Gate the Queued suppression on log content, not status: render view_attempt_log for Queued rows whose attempt_log carries events (or check corrected_at/form_opened_at), keeping the suppression for never-started rows.

warnings.title: Taken-over ContactInitiated rows still render the 'Next reminder in ~2 days if there's no reply' hint though takeover cancels the sweep
warnings.detail: Takeover NULLs next_attempt_at and the sweep excludes taken-over rows — no reminder will ever fire — yet the hint (refcheck_what_happens_next) still promises one. Reachable on every warm handoff (take-over is offered on contact_initiated rows and keeps the status). Misleading promise in the evidence-grade timeline the story exists to build.
warnings.recommended_fix: Suppress has_next_reminder when the row is taken over (taken_over(call) is already available in the module) — or show the truthful 'you took this over' context instead.

warnings.title: Failed/skipped send channels render as 'sent' in the timeline and export, and the reminder ordinal overwrites the failure detail — the evidence record overclaims
warnings.detail: W6 fixed the co-nudge case only. For invitation/reminder batches the label is unconditional ('Reminder N sent — email + SMS') even when a channel's outcome is failed or skipped ('no email contact on file' is stamped on every channel-less send), and the ordinal replaces the failure detail for reminders — a landlord exporting the record sees 'sent' for sends that never went out.
warnings.recommended_fix: Make the label outcome-aware (e.g. 'Reminder N — not sent' when no channel delivered) and keep the attempt's failure detail on the line instead of only the ordinal — mirroring the W6 co-nudge treatment.
